title: _updatePhUSDEmissionRate truncates phUSDPerSecond to zero for small totalStaked at low APY, silently disabling phUSD emission
rootCause: `phUSDPerSecond = (totalStaked * desiredAPYBps) / 10000 / SECONDS_PER_YEAR`. Integer-division floor truncates to zero when `totalStaked * desiredAPYBps < 3.1536e11`. Bites sub-1bps APY or sub-MINIMUM_STAKE positions.
impactSummary: Silent under-payment of phUSD rewards at boundary configurations. Practical scope limited because MINIMUM_STAKE prevents most cases.
preservedDetails: CODE-013 carries the analysis and the dust-handler interaction.
remediation: Reorder to maximize precision (multiply first), or treat phUSDPerSecond as PRECISION-scaled to mirror the stable accumulator.
dedupNotes: Not produced by static tools. Pattern-DB DIVISION-PRECISION was skipped (no harmful div-before-mul per profile §8.9). This is a corner-case boundary defect distinct from that signature.
